controls: Catalogue response Date and publication date must be current enough for the monthly release and recorded in UTC.
Every required authority must resolve to exactly one visible current download link in the catalogue document.
Authority link text, slug, expected authority and href filename must agree after conservative normalization.
Streamed download byte count must equal declared Content-Length when present and the final file size.
Every redirect hop must remain HTTPS on an approved HMLR host and be included in the download receipt.
Partial resume is forbidden unless ETag and exact byte range continuity are proven; otherwise restart cleanly.
Every accepted archive member must pass CRC validation before any GML is opened.
Archive members must use an approved non-encrypted compression method and reject unsupported methods.
Member timestamps must be plausible for the current release and not far-future or implausibly ancient.
GML root namespaces and application schema must match the expected HMLR INSPIRE cadastral document.
XML parsing must disable external entities, DTD retrieval and network schema loading.
Selected GML bytes must retain the same SHA before Fiona/lxml parsing and after feature scanning.
Every selected geometry must carry or inherit one unambiguous British National Grid CRS declaration.
Coordinate lists must contain finite easting/northing pairs with valid even cardinality.
Exterior and interior rings must be explicitly closed and contain enough distinct vertices.
GeometryCollection or mixed non-polygon content must block production exact matching.
The same INSPIRE ID appearing in multiple current authority archives must be classified and fail ambiguous.
Reprojected candidate BNG coordinates and transformer definition must be hashed and propagated to the match.
covers, contains and boundary-only outcomes must be stored separately; boundary policy cannot be implicit.
Selected polygon must record finite exact point-to-boundary distance in metres before acceptance.
Original validity reason and repaired validity result must be retained with topology and area changes.
Raw full-precision polygon area must be retained separately from rounded presentation area.
Chosen result must include one normalized safe archive-member path with archive and member SHA lineage.
Output results must contain exactly the three target rows in canonical order with no extra blocked-history rows.
Any source, parse, geometry or ambiguity failure must atomically publish blocked status and zero measurement promotion.
